description: Compares documentation claims (replit.md, prior phase artifacts) against code evidence (schema.ts, package.json, tests, configs). Identifies alignment, divergence, and resolution for each feature area.

convergence_items.docs_claim: Phase 14.5 convergence plan: 'Dashboard, Missions, NOVA AI, Chronilog, Systems, Profile'
convergence_items.code_truth: Operator correction: 5 primary tabs are Dashboard, Missions, AI, Chronilog, Profile. Systems is NOT primary.
convergence_items.resolution: Operator correction supersedes. Profile is 5th primary tab, not Systems.

convergence_items.docs_claim: Phase 14.5/14.5A: Target auth is Clerk. Current auth described as 'Firebase or Passport.js legacy'.
convergence_items.code_truth: package.json: passport 0.7.0, passport-local 1.0.0, bcrypt 6.0.0, firebase 11.6.1, firebase-admin 13.6.1, express-session 1.18.1, connect-pg-simple 10.0.0. Zero Clerk dependencies.
convergence_items.resolution: Current truth is Passport.js + Firebase dual auth. Clerk is a future migration target only. No code exists for Clerk.

convergence_items.docs_claim: Phase 14.5A: 'Fly.io deployment' as desired end state. Current: 'Deployed isolated MVP at lyfeos.net. Deployment mechanism unclear.'
convergence_items.code_truth: Replit-specific dependencies (@replit/vite-plugin-*), build.sh, operator confirms Replit hosting.
convergence_items.resolution: Current deployment is Replit. Fly.io is a future migration target. Prior artifacts were uncertain about current hosting; now confirmed as Replit.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 'NOVA AI System'. Prior artifacts sometimes reference 'NOVA' as a system name.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: aiAssistantName default 'NOVA' in user_stats. Field is mutable and user-renamable.
convergence_items.resolution: NOVA is the default AI companion name, stored per-user and renamable. Not a system/brand name.

convergence_items.docs_claim: Phase 14.5: '35 tables'. replit.md lists key data models.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: exactly 35 pgTable() declarations, independently verified.
convergence_items.resolution: 35 tables confirmed. Docs and code agree.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 'Exponential growth curve across three tiers of levels (1-10, 11-50, 51-100) with increasing XP multipliers.'
convergence_items.code_truth: xp-calculations.test.ts: Tier 1 (1.0372x), Tier 2 (1.0572x), Tier 3 (1.0872x). Base 1000. Level cap 100.
convergence_items.resolution: Docs and test code agree precisely.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 'Energy Points, Health Points, Wealth Tokens, Time Tokens, Attention Tokens (all starting at 100/100)'
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: All 5 tokens with current/max pairs, defaults 100/100.
convergence_items.resolution: Perfect alignment between docs and code.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md mentions onboarding missions. No specific count in replit.md.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: onboardingMission default 0, comment 'Current mission (0-7)' = 8 missions.
convergence_items.resolution: Code is more precise than docs. 8 missions confirmed.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 54-question archetype calibration. 6 archetypes listed as part of data models.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: archetypePrimary/Secondary/Shadow, archetypeScores JSONB with warrior/architect/creator/monarch/oracle/alchemist keys.
convergence_items.resolution: 6 archetypes confirmed in both. 54-question count from docs only (not verifiable in snapshot).

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 'Real Google OAuth flow for Calendar (read/write) and Tasks (readonly)'. Detailed sync, dedup, token refresh docs.
convergence_items.code_truth: package.json: googleapis 171.4.0. schema.ts: integrations table with OAuth fields, calendar_events with externalId, quests with externalId/externalSource.
convergence_items.resolution: Schema and deps fully support documented features.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 'Stripe integration removed (stubbed endpoints preserved for future reconnection).'
convergence_items.code_truth: No stripe dependency in package.json. schema.ts retains stripeCustomerId and stripeSubscriptionId fields.
convergence_items.resolution: Removal confirmed. Stub fields retained as documented.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: Google Drive-style with List/Grid views, folder nesting, markdown editing, media upload, bidirectional sync (Google Drive, Obsidian, Evernote).
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: folders (with parentId), documents (with source/externalId/externalUrl/lastSyncedAt), templates. adm-zip dep supports .zip import.
convergence_items.resolution: Schema supports all documented features. Sync implementation details in server code not in snapshot.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 3 default views (Board, List, Calendar) + Notion-style custom views.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: mission_views table with viewType, filters, columns, sortBy, sortDirection.
convergence_items.resolution: Schema supports custom view persistence. Default views are likely code-defined, not DB-stored.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: Web Vibration API with configurable patterns. Toggle in Profile Settings.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: hapticFeedback boolean in user_profile, default true.
convergence_items.resolution: Preference storage confirmed. Implementation in client/src/lib/haptics.ts documented but not in snapshot.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: Web Audio API synthesized sounds. No external audio files. Toggle in Profile Settings.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: soundEffects boolean in user_profile, default true.
convergence_items.resolution: Preference storage confirmed. No audio file dependencies in package.json supports 'no external files' claim.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md mentions rate limiting. Phase 14.5A layer 9: 'No rate limiting.'
convergence_items.code_truth: No express-rate-limit or similar dependency in package.json. Custom middleware possible but not confirmed.
convergence_items.resolution: Docs disagree with each other. replit.md mentions rate limiting exists; phase 14.5A says it doesn't. Code evidence (no rate-limit dep) suggests it may be custom middleware or absent.

convergence_items.docs_claim: No specific Apple Health documentation in replit.md beyond mentioning it in integrations table.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: userIntegrations.appleHealthConnected boolean field only. No Apple HealthKit SDK or API dependency.
convergence_items.resolution: Schema has placeholder boolean. No implementation evidence. Likely a planned feature with schema pre-created.

convergence_items.docs_claim: No specific Notion integration documentation in replit.md beyond mentioning it in integrations table.
convergence_items.code_truth: schema.ts: userIntegrations.notionConnected boolean field only. No Notion SDK dependency.
convergence_items.resolution: Schema has placeholder boolean. No implementation evidence. Planned feature.

convergence_items.docs_claim: replit.md: 'Security headers (Helmet)'. Phase 14.5A: 'No security headers confirmed.'
convergence_items.code_truth: package.json: helmet 8.1.0 in dependencies.
convergence_items.resolution: Helmet dependency confirms security headers are present. Phase 14.5A claim was incorrect; helmet dep proves it.

convergence_items.docs_claim: Phase 14.5: 'No integration -- isolated MVP'. Phase 14.5A: 'Not UMH-connected'.
convergence_items.code_truth: projections/lyfeos/integration/ exists in UMH codebase (1184 lines). But LyfeOS app code has zero UMH references.
convergence_items.resolution: LyfeOS is isolated. UMH has prepared a one-way integration layer (direct Postgres polling) that LyfeOS is unaware of.

summary.notes: LyfeOS has the best docs-to-code alignment of the Trinity apps. replit.md is comprehensive and largely accurate. Main contradictions are in prior phase artifacts that were working from incomplete information.
